_comment: STILL image generation (studio headshots and portraits).
Hand this whole file to the image model, or paste one of the
strings under 'prompts'. GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render
is the reference image that video.json requires.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: stocky and solid, thick shoulders, work-worn hands with visible callouses and short square nails

face: broad open face, wide easy grin with laugh lines around dark brown eyes, weathered mid-brown skin with sun texture on the forehead and cheekbones, greying stubble
hair: short natural hair going grey at the sides, slight thinning at the crown

wardrobe.teaching: faded blue work overalls with the top unbuttoned to the waist and sleeves tied off, plain t-shirt underneath, scuffed work boots
alternates: short-sleeve khaki work shirt and jeans

accessories: a battered aluminium kettle held in one hand

presence.posture: crouches or leans over the object he is explaining, one hand demonstrating the motion; rarely stands formally
presence.default_expression: delighted mischief - the look of a man about to show you something obvious you never noticed

_environment_reference: sunlit backyard or workshop, a wheelbarrow and tools in frame, corrugated fence, dust in the light
_environment_note: NOT used for platform imagery - tutors are shot in studio. Owner, 2026-07-28: the student left the teachers in the classroom, so the platform does not show one. Kept only as character reference if a composite is ever wanted.
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

Hair: short natural hair going grey at the sides, slight thinning at the crown. Wearing faded blue work overalls with the top unbuttoned to the waist and sleeves tied off, plain t-shirt underneath, scuffed work boots. a battered aluminium kettle held in one hand. Expression: delighted mischief - the look of a man about to show you something obvious you never noticed. Chest-up, slight three-quarter turn, eyes to camera. large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop. full-frame mirrorless, 85mm f/1.8. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, glassy doll eyes, vacant thousand-yard stare, identical catchlights in both eyes, flat matte irises, eyes looking through the camera, mismatched gaze direction, classroom, school desks, chalkboard, whiteboard, notice boards, posters, any writing or notation in frame, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, set dressing, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the cinematic terms are deliberate - image models drift toward a film-still look (grade, motion blur, flare) and then the render stops reading as a photograph

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn

studio.lighting: two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop
studio.framing: waist-up, centred or slightly off-centre with clean space beside the head for overlaid text
studio.backdrop: seamless warm neutral grey paper, evenly lit, no props, no furniture, no set dressing

_prop_note: ONE named object, never a list: a menu of props reads as an instruction to invent one. Swap the kettle for another single item here and in prompts if you prefer.
